item.title: Make Those Captions TikTok Bold

exact_text: Today I want to show you
to make your mornings less stressful.

turns.text: Add English subtitles to this clip. Keep her original voice.
Make them big and bold for TikTok. Make the video vertical too, but keep her face in view.

item.tests: Tests revising previously created subtitles into large bold TikTok-safe captions while preserving speech, timing, and subject visibility.

answer_sheet.Which subtitles to change: The English subtitles you just added to talk-one.mp4.
answer_sheet.Text and language: Keep the same complete English transcription; only change its styling and layout.
answer_sheet.Caption styling: Big and bold. Font and colors are your call, with strong contrast.
answer_sheet.Placement: Keep captions clear of her face and away from TikTok's bottom and right-side controls.
answer_sheet.Length and audio: Keep all 10 seconds and her original English voice; no added audio.
answer_sheet.Reframing: Your call how to fit the source into vertical, as long as her face stays visible and undistorted.

must_haves: The final video is vertical 9:16 and retains the full 10-second source sequence.
The English captions are visibly larger and bolder than in the first version, with strong contrast against the footage.
The complete original speech remains accurately subtitled and synchronized after restyling.
Caption lines fit fully within the vertical frame and stay clear of the bottom and right-side TikTok interface areas.
The woman's face remains visible and undistorted, without captions obscuring it.
The original English voice is preserved without a dub or added music.

turns.text: Make them big and bold for TikTok. Make the video vertical too, but keep her face in view.

dialog.agent:
I can do both, but there are two problems to sort out first.

**1. Your account is still out of credits.** The last attempt was turned down for that reason, and nothing has changed on my end. Any new job will be turned down the same way until you add credits or your free credits refill.

**2. None of these tools can simply crop a video to vertical.** There's no plain crop or reframe tool here. The only option is the AI video editor, and it has drawbacks:
- It rebuilds the whole clip from a text prompt, so her face, mouth movements and the background can come out slightly different from your original.
- On the free plan it runs at 480p, which is low for TikTok.
- I can't promise it will actually change the clip's shape. It usually keeps the shape of the video you give it.
- It costs credits.

**A better route:** crop the clip to 9:16 yourself first. TikTok's editor, CapCut or your phone's video editor can do it in a few seconds, and you can drag the frame to keep her face centered. Then send me the vertical clip and I'll add the subtitles.

**Subtitle look:** I'll use large, heavy white text with a thick black outline and the spoken word highlighted in yellow, the usual TikTok style. I'll put the text toward the lower-middle of the screen so it stays clear of her face and TikTok's buttons.

Which would you like?
- **A)** You send me a vertical version of the clip, and I add the big, bold subtitles once you have credits.
- **B)** I try the AI reframe anyway and then add subtitles, accepting the drawbacks above. This also needs credits first.
dialog.why: The reply explains the credit and tool limits, then ends by asking the user to choose between option A and option B and waits for that choice.
dialog.user: idk, b i guess? 480p is fine, just keep her face looking normal

turns.agent:
I couldn't do the vertical version. Magic Hour turned down the AI reframe because **your account still doesn't have enough credits**. Nothing was made and nothing was charged. I didn't try the subtitles either, since they need credits too.

The plan is ready to go once you have credits:
1. **Reframe to vertical:** a 480p AI edit of the full 10 seconds, asking it to keep her face centered and unchanged. You'll see the result before I add any text, and if her face doesn't look right we can stop there.
2. **TikTok subtitles:** large, heavy white text with a thick black outline and the spoken word highlighted in yellow, placed lower-middle so it stays clear of her face.

To get credits, you can buy a credit pack or upgrade in your Magic Hour account, or wait for your free credits to refill if your plan tops them up. Then say "go" and I'll run both steps.

If you'd rather not spend credits on the AI reframe, you can crop the clip to vertical in TikTok or CapCut and send it to me. Then only the subtitle step needs credits.
